description: Permissions of the main window, the quick-download windows (quick-*) and the floating ball (float): their own title bar (move, resize, minimise, maximise, close), showing themselves after the first frame, a quick-download window fitting its height to what it shows, following the theme, the folder picker and (exporting the task list) the save dialog. Downloads go through Omni Download commands only (docs/development-plan.md §8.1).
